description: 河川復育英文版案例報導 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 「資料來源為本署河川復育網與ｅ河川網站，110年7月已關站，本資料不再更新」。 本資料集主要係就河川復育蒐集國內、國外的河川復育案例，以英文版案例報導，除提供國內民眾河川復育知識宣導，亦可透過本網站與國際進行知識交流，提高臺灣的能見度；自2000年至今，包含水利及水土保持相關單位多融入生態工程之概念於施作工程中，以當地天然材料為建材，進行... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
